verdict.rationale: Slack's Workflow Builder lets users set up no-code automations triggered by events or external webhooks, including conditional branching, which run autonomously in the background without manual invocation once configured (slack-docs-10, slack-docs-11, slack-docs-12, slack-docs-41). The Events API further supports background-triggered automations that fire when Slack detects relevant activity (slack-docs-6, slack-docs-7, slack-docs-31). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of long-running autonomous workflows in production, and clearer tie-in to AI-driven (vs. simple rule-based) automation logic.
